_comment: Channel registry. One entry per publishing destination. The generator allocates topics per channel, the compliance gate enforces cross-channel uniqueness, and render-batch routes each upload to the right adapter.
_cross_channel_warning: Publishing the same or near-identical video to two channels is a mass-produced content risk across the whole estate, not just within one channel. The gate blocks it. Give each channel its own niches.

channels.notes: Primary channel. The daily-shorts workflow publishes here.
channels.oauthNote: Consent screen MUST stay In production. In Testing, Google expires refresh tokens after 7 days, which silently killed publishing between 3 and 8 Aug 2026. Check console.cloud.google.com/auth/audience?project=yt-shorts-engine

channels.notes: NOT connected to Composio despite the other two being connected, and has no YT2_* secrets. Needs its own Google sign-in: npm run yt:rotate -- --channel=yt-bbm0902
channels._channelId_note: Taken from the videos.insert response, which is authoritative. An earlier hand-transcribed value had the i and I at positions 21-22 transposed, which made the wrong-channel guard fire on a correct upload. Never retype a channel id: copy it from an API response.

channels.notes: Publishes via Composio (scripts/instagram-upload-composio.mjs), which already holds an ACTIVE authenticated connection and manages the token lifecycle. That removes the Meta app build, App Review, and the 60-day token refresh that would otherwise kill publishing silently. Needs COMPOSIO_API_KEY as a GitHub secret. scripts/instagram-upload.mjs remains as the direct-Meta fallback. Instagram still fetches the video from a public URL, so publish-media.mjs is still required.
channels._niche_note: Matched to the account's stated brand (weekly AI-video saga, gaming). Publishing animal and space facts to a gaming account is off-brand, and Instagram reads topical consistency hard on a small account: it would suppress reach on both these posts and any gaming content later.

channels.notes: Added 10 Sep 2026 at the channel owner's request: Quran and Hadith content, five languages per post (English UK, Arabic, Mandarin Chinese, Korean, Japanese), posted as Instagram carousels rather than video Reels. Publishes via Composio (scripts/instagram-upload-carousel-composio.mjs), a NEW script written for this channel - the existing instagram-upload-composio.mjs only drives the single-media Reels path and does not build carousel container arguments correctly. Live-verified 10 Sep 2026 via INSTAGRAM_GET_USER_INFO: account_type=MEDIA_CREATOR (publishing-eligible; personal accounts are rejected by Meta's API), 0 followers/0 media (brand new), publish quota 100 posts/24h with 0 used (INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_USER_CONTENT_PUBLISHING_LIMIT). Composio's own connection listing labels this account_type 'PRIVATE', which is a Composio-internal label, not Meta's - confirmed by the identical label appearing on ig-aigameodyssey's connection despite that channel publishing successfully every day; the real Meta account_type is the MEDIA_CREATOR value above, read live from the Graph API.
channels._niche_note: Religious source content (Quran, Hadith). Verse/hadith text and every language rendering must trace to a named, citable source (surah:ayah + translator; collection/book/number/grade) rather than being generated freehand - misquoting scripture is a materially different risk than getting a trivia fact wrong. See VISUAL-DIRECTION-BRIEF.md for the sourcing approach.
channels._cadence_note: Owner wants a variable number of carousels per day (not a fixed dailyCount/weekendCount like the other channels), spaced 20 to 60 minutes apart, sized to however much verified content is ready that day. dailyCount/weekendCount are left null here deliberately rather than guessed at; see the scheduling note in VISUAL-DIRECTION-BRIEF.md for how posts are actually paced.
channels._routing_note: render-batch.mjs's Instagram branch previously read COMPOSIO_IG_ACCOUNT_ID/IG_USER_ID from a single pair of global env vars with no per-channel selection - correct for exactly one Instagram channel, silently wrong for two. Fixed 10 Sep 2026 to resolve composioConnection/igUserId from this channel object instead. Neither value is secret (they are identifiers, not credentials); only COMPOSIO_API_KEY needs to stay a GitHub secret, and it is already shared correctly across both Instagram channels.

instagram_limits._source: Meta Instagram Platform, Content Publishing. 100 API-published posts per rolling 24h.

_enabled_note: All four channels are enabled. A channel without its credentials is SKIPPED with a clear message rather than failing the run, so enabling early is safe. Check `npm run channels` for live readiness.
_cadence: 4 clips per weekday per channel, plus 2 extra at the weekend flagged as special, for the three video channels. Weekend specials get the premium visual treatment (see specialTreatment in the generator). ig-blankdiscussions is the exception: a variable number of carousels per day, spaced through the day rather than rendered in one batch - see its own _cadence_note.
